label: crop_closeup
description: Close view of crop plant leaves stems fruit or canopy where crop tissue is the main subject
notes: Useful before disease and pest analysis when plant parts are visible.

label: crop_field
description: Wider field scene where a cultivated crop stand is visible
notes: May route to crop identification later but not directly to leaf disease inference.

label: bare_soil_empty_land
description: Mostly bare prepared soil fallow plot or empty agricultural land with no dominant crop canopy
notes: Public ground-level coverage is weak; project field images are required.

label: weed_dominant_field
description: Field or plot where weeds or unwanted vegetation dominate the scene
notes: Public weed datasets are useful only as auxiliary data because most are species closeups.

label: harvested_field
description: Post-harvest field with stubble residue cut crop rows or cleared crop remnants

label: waterlogged_land
description: Agricultural land with standing water flood stress or saturated field conditions
notes: Public aerial flood data is only a proxy; local field images are needed.

label: non_agricultural_land
description: Scene dominated by roads buildings vehicles indoor areas forest or other non-farm context
notes: Use as a negative class to prevent forced farm predictions.

label: unknown_or_unclear
description: Image is too blurry dark occluded ambiguous or outside the known taxonomy
notes: Should be used for low-confidence or unreadable inputs.
